# Keep the picture current

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

Use this when **system notes already exist** under `docs/system/` and something was added that the picture does not show yet.

The picture is three places: the short description in `landscape.md`, the context diagram in `diagrams.md`, and how the parts connect (`## How the parts connect` in `landscape.md`).

Run `$crav1-refresh-system-notes`? `$crav1-build-features` asks when a slice is marked done or retired. `$crav1-fix-bug` and `$crav1-fix-build-gaps` ask when the fix changes how the parts connect. `$crav1-read-environment` asks after lines are added to `docs/environments/marks.md`. `$crav1-add-to-spec` asks once at the end of a run that came from read-environment or suggest-tests-for-code, not once per item. `$crav1-build-tasks` do not ask.

This is not [from the repos](from-existing-to-specs-repos-only.md) (`$crav1-existing-to-specs`).

## First prompt

```text
$crav1-refresh-system-notes
@docs/system/
@docs/specs/

Add what the specs already state to the picture. Do not rewrite what is already there. Do not write code.
```

## Steps

| Phase | You | Agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Notes | — | Stops when `docs/system/` is missing. Points at spark, ideas, intake, match, or existing-to-specs when the user named repos and brought no dump. Does not seed the folder |
| What is new | — | A part or a connection a spec already states and the picture does not. Skips a sentence marked inferred. Does not invent one from the repo |
| Write | Glance | Appends a sentence, a diagram node or edge, or a connection line. Leaves existing lines as they are |
| Stop | `$crav1-finalize-commit` if a file changed | Does not plan, implement, or commit. Names that command only when a file changed |

## What gets written

No `plan.md`. No `tasks.md`. Reading specs does not set `Synced at`. When this run reads a whole repo, it sets that repo's `Synced at` line in `repos.md` and touches only those repos. When this run reads only one slice, it does not touch the `## Synced at` section. It writes or updates `Synced at: <repo> <branch>@<short sha>, <date>` in that slice's `spec.md`.

It does not look at how `docs/notes/` is laid out. Notes still flat in `docs/notes/` from before 1.61.0 are still read; to move them into month folders, run `notes_index.py migrate-dry-run`, then `notes_index.py migrate`, by hand (see [data layout](concepts/data-layout.md)).

## After

`Run next: nothing needed now.` When a file changed: `Uncommitted: 1 file; commit with $crav1-finalize-commit when ready.` See [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md).
